go.scope: all v2 packages including legacy and experimental packages

experimentalFoundry.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.experiments.yml -p zkdpp-experiments run --rm foundry test -vv
experimentalFoundry.note: Test functions replay multiple transactions; Anvil separately enforces the per-transaction 30M limit.

hotfixRegression.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.hotfix.yml -p zkdpp-v2-m1-hotfix run --rm foundry test -vv

auditNodeFailure.remediation: Audit-only node without step tracing; clean node per graph; incremental immutable progress rows.

developmentCorrections: Initial Docker and local HTTP test access required sandbox escalation.
Experimental Foundry import paths were corrected before successful compilation.
Initial setup profile JSON encoded a field as Montgomery limbs; loader now accepts that archived encoding and emits canonical field strings.
Development Go compile issues (RandomScalar reader argument, unused import, share array-to-slice conversion) were corrected before measurements.
Route diagnostics were moved after the final receipt and immutable-record caching was scoped to one audit execution before formal measurements.
